description: 7-day wind forecast — internal view. Includes observation overlays and wind direction diagnostics. For wind_nbm, data is shown for two heights (20 m and 60 m) and observed values come from obs_wspd_kt / obs_wdir_degrees. Internal use only.

panels.description: Wind speed forecast at 20 m. wind_nbm values are converted from m/s to knots and filtered to the most recent startdt at-or-before the 'From' time (within 6 h).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  windspdmean,
  windspdlb,
  windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  windspdlb AS windspdlb,
  windspdub AS windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = 20
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND startdt >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '6 hours'
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = '$group'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = 20
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY "time"

panels.title: Current Wind Speed (60 m)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  MOD(MOD(winddirmean::numeric,360)+360,360) AS winddirmean,
  MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) AS winddirlb,
  MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) AS winddirub,
  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN 0 ELSE MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) END AS band_lo_bot,
  MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) AS band_lo_top,
  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) ELSE NULL END AS band_hi_bot,
  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN 360 ELSE NULL END AS band_hi_top
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  MOD(MOD(winddirmean::numeric,360)+360,360) AS winddirmean,
  MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) AS winddirlb,

  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN 0 ELSE MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) END AS band_lo_bot,
  MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) AS band_lo_top,
  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360) ELSE NULL END AS band_hi_bot,
  CASE WHEN (MOD(MOD(winddirub::numeric,360)+360,360) < MOD(MOD(winddirlb::numeric,360)+360,360)) THEN 360 ELSE NULL END AS band_hi_top
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = 20
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()

panels.description: Latest wind speed per location. For wind_nbm, separate columns are shown for each height.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  MAX(ts) AS "Last Updated",
  MAX(CASE WHEN h = 20 OR h IS NULL THEN val END) AS "Wind Speed @ 20 m",
  MAX(CASE WHEN h = 60 THEN val END) AS "Wind Speed @ 60 m"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, height_m)
    locname,
    height_m AS h,
    timestamp AS ts,
    CASE WHEN model = 'wind_nbm' THEN windspdmean ELSE windspdmean END AS val
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, height_m, timestamp DESC
) sub
GROUP BY locname
ORDER BY locname

panels.title: Wind Speed by Location (latest per location)

panels.description: Observed vs forecast wind speed at 20 m. For wind_nbm, observed is obs_wspd_kt; for legacy models the existing windspd column is used.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  windspd AS windspd
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  NULL::float AS windspd
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = 20
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND startdt >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '6 hours'
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = '$group'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = 20
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  NULL::float AS windspdmean,
  obs_wspd_kt AS windspd
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
  AND fhr = 0
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = 20
  AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
)
SELECT "time", MAX(windspdmean) AS windspdmean, MAX(windspd) AS windspd
FROM u
GROUP BY "time"
ORDER BY "time"
